verdict.rationale: Kong's declarative configuration model and the decK APIOps CLI let you define and apply gateway configuration for many entities (services, routes, plugins) as a single file. kongctl also supports migrating existing configurations in one pass. Together these imply many-items-at-once changes, but no evidence describes bulk operations explicitly. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of bulk create/update/delete operations, batch Admin API endpoints, bulk actions in the UI or MCP server, and any hands-on corroboration of large-scale bulk changes.
